limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not been run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
implementation: Eight 1-bit D flip-flops capture d on the positive edge of clk and asynchronously clear q to zero on active-high areset, with reset priority.
interface: TopModule(clk, areset, d[7:0], q[7:0]); no additional ports or latency.
static_review: Explicit 8-bit assignments, nonblocking sequential updates, one output driver, no initialization or extra behavior in RTL.
testbench_coverage: All 256 data words, data changes between clock edges, falling-edge hold, reset with clock low and high, reset release without capture, and reset held through a rising edge.
